actual_upstream.full_closure_consequence: Q1 reaches CMP_CLK/PHI_W/PHI_U; LIVE reaches SAMPLE_INT and token ACTIVE. PHI_W depends on comparator receiver, comparator and DAC, PHI_U on write delay and token/reference updates. Unrestricted upstream closure reconstructs most of the integrated ADC.

retained_CLOCK_SET_load.policy: Retain the full XCLOCK SR latch, including its NAND drain/source dynamics and MOM load; do not replace CLOCK_SET with a guessed capacitor.

downstream_CLOCK_Q_cut.expression: I(X025.X000.MP:G) + I(X025.X000.MN:G), original currents positive into each MOS gate
downstream_CLOCK_Q_cut.reason: Preserve measured baseline buffer gate-current history without pulling comparator/receiver/bit-chain loading into this minimal subnetwork.

differences_from_closed_loop: Q1/LIVE/CLOCK_RESET are forced to measured baseline voltage histories. Original upstream drive impedance and its response to local perturbations are removed.
SR latch internal feedback is retained. Its downstream global timing, comparator, write, update and token feedback into the replayed inputs is cut.
CLOCK_Q downstream load is a measured current replay, not a voltage-dependent live buffer. It reproduces only the captured baseline trajectory; it cannot predict a modified circuit's load response.
Replay source currents represent imposed boundary conditions. They must be recorded in KCL, not mistaken for a newly designed analog clamp or an ADC reliability fix.

input_history.meaning: Preserve baseline DC-start and pre-peak history; do not start a replay at the peak with guessed state
input_history.SR_initial_state_requirement: Resolve local SR/DC-state ambiguity against recorded baseline CLOCK_Q/RB/SN/QB and RC-node initial values before executing.

required_native_measurement.sign_convention: Spectre native terminal current positive from named node into named device; sum all incident terminal currents at a node for KCL. Current plotted as injection into node has the opposite sign.
required_native_measurement.interpretation: Use total native terminal currents including charge dynamics and multiplicity. Do not multiply by multi again or identify a terminal transient as pure channel leakage.
required_native_measurement.trace_gate: Every requested current/voltage must exist in native TRACE with case-sensitive identity and accepted port numbering. Missing, auto-fallback or unsupported terminal saves block KCL interpretation; never fill missing traces with zero.
required_native_measurement.capture_mode: Future managed unchanged-baseline measurement-only save pass, followed by bounded native-time replay export. No remote acquisition authorized in this specification.
required_native_measurement.current_trace_data_status: Not present in the already reviewed control compact export

source_attribution_questions: At the positive X020.N slew and peak, which signed MP0/MP1/MN0 drain or post-inverter gate currents inject or withdraw charge?
Does MID charge/current redistribution precede the N excursion, or does a Q1/LIVE input edge dominate the recorded input-gate and drain current timing?
What current is returned through the restoring inverter, real RC clear network and CLOCK_SET load? Interpret total terminal currents without claiming a unique Cgd/Cgs split.
